configurations.tada_agent: TADA-Agent with the released TADA skill and atom APIs
configurations.claude_code: same coding-agent harness without the TADA skill or atom APIs
configurations.code_only: code-generation baseline without the TADA atoms

evaluation_tracks.row_aligned: Reference-based pairwise comparison for cases without a rule-based answer; differing cells are judgment units.
evaluation_tracks.complete_artifact: Reference-based pairwise comparison of complete deliverables for non-row-aligned cases without a rule-based answer.

tabench.reference_role: One held-out TADA run provides a common relative comparison scale for cases without a unique answer; it is not ground truth.

judge.protocol: anonymized A/B, position swapping, three votes per direction

large_scale.categorization_scope: Controlled candidate-retention study under fixed canonical assignments
large_scale.retention_artifacts: Not present in the original handoff; the supplementary material provides the complete protocol and aggregate outcomes.

public_benchmarks.scope: Sanitized manifests, predictions, summaries, and experiment logic available in the local handoff.

boundary_diagnostic.scope: Single-run neural-symbolic diagnostic; mechanism evidence, not a comparative system benchmark.
